name.en: Ouma vs Renji Kaga Second-Round Match

periods.summary: Ouma Kurogane defeats Steel Grizzly Renji Kaga in A-block second round before Ikki's group discusses the compressed schedule.
periods.cause: Tournament second round begins under the newly compressed schedule.
periods.process: The text references the match at the point where Ikki's group learns the committee's reasons for schedule compression, indicating A-block's Ouma-versus-Kaga match has just produced a winner.
periods.outcome: Ouma advances through A-block second round.
periods.aftermath: Attention shifts to the C-block second-round matches involving Sara, Kurando, Ikki and Byakuya.
periods.significance: Keeps Ouma, one of the leading championship candidates and Stella's target, in the tournament during the accelerated rounds.
